Concept Plus Careers

Database Developer

Database Developer

About Concept Plus

Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. Headquartered in Fairfax, VA, we bring the agility, responsiveness, and customer intimacy of a small business combined with the quality and infrastructure of a larger firm.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

For more information, visit www.conceptplus.com.

About the role

Concept Plus is seeking a highly skilled Database Developer with expertise in Oracle database technologies, geospatial data management, AI-enabled database capabilities, and cloud-based solutions. The successful candidate will design, develop, optimize, and support enterprise-scale database solutions that enable mission-critical applications, analytics, geospatial intelligence, APIs, and emerging AI use cases.

 

This role requires a strong background in database development, data modeling, performance optimization, data migration, and collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing data solutions.

What you'll do

Database Development & Design

Design, develop, and maintain Oracle database solutions supporting enterprise and mission-critical applications.
Create and optimize database schemas, tables, indexes, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, and PL/SQL code.
Develop secure and performant SQL and PL/SQL solutions that support applications, reporting, analytics, and APIs.
Design logical and physical data models that ensure scalability, maintainability, and data integrity.
Analyze and tune database performance, query execution plans, indexing strategies, and resource utilization.

Geospatial Data Management

Develop database solutions that support geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) workloads.
Manage and optimize raster and vector geospatial datasets.
Design and implement spatial indexing, queries, and services to support advanced geospatial analytics and applications.
Support the integration of geospatial data into enterprise platforms and workflows.

AI & Advanced Data Solutions

Implement Oracle Database capabilities that support AI and machine learning use cases.
Develop solutions leveraging:
Vector data types
Embeddings
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
Support AI-driven applications through efficient storage, retrieval, and management of vectorized data.

Multimodel Database Development

Design and implement Oracle database solutions that integrate:
Relational data models
JSON data
JSON Relational Duality
Spatial data
Graph data structures
Ensure high performance, data consistency, and effective integration across multiple data types.

Data Migration & Integration

Analyze source systems and map data structures for migration and modernization initiatives.
Develop and execute data migration, transformation, and validation strategies.
Perform data reconciliation and validation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and performance following migrations.
Support migrations from MongoDB and other document databases into Oracle Database environments.

Collaboration & Support

Collaborate with application developers, cloud engineers, AI teams, data engineers, and security stakeholders to deliver database solutions.
Document database designs, standards, operational procedures, and deployment processes.
Troubleshoot complex database issues and implement corrective actions.
Communicate technical concepts, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

US Citizen
Active TS/SCI Clearance
8+ years relevant experience to this position
Demonstrated experience architecting, implementing, and optimizing Oracle Database solutions for complex enterprise or mission workloads, including logical and physical data design, performance tuning, security, backup/recovery, and operational support.
Experience managing geospatial intelligence data, including raster and vector formats, and designing database structures, indexing, queries, and services that support scalable spatial analytics.
Proven ability to design multimodel Oracle Database solutions that integrate relational, spatial, JSON including JSON Relational Duality, and graph data types while preserving data integrity, usability, and performance.
Hands-on experience enabling AI use cases in Oracle Database using vector data types, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
Experience developing secure, performant SQL, PL/SQL, schemas, packages, views, and data-access patterns that support applications, analytics, APIs, and downstream consumers.
Ability to assess source systems, map data structures, define migration and conversion strategies, and validate data quality, completeness, reconciliation, and performance after implementation.
Experience collaborating with application, AI, data-engineering, cloud, and security teams to translate requirements into maintainable database designs and operational runbooks.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to explain database risks, design decisions, and remediation approaches to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of OCI, including database deployment, networking, identity, storage, monitoring, and security services.
Experience creating and deploying RESTful APIs and integrating with Oracle API Gateway or comparable API-management capabilities.
Experience with Oracle AI Database 26ai, Oracle Exadata, and/or OCI Autonomous AI Database Service on Exadata.
Experience migrating Oracle Databases from on-premises or other cloud environments into OCI using Zero Downtime Migration, Data Pump, GoldenGate, or comparable tooling.
Experience migrating JSON data from MongoDB or comparable document stores into Oracle Database and validating compatibility, data fidelity, and performance.

Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As such, we will give your application full consideration without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
